data.title: Nav bar adapts color to light/dark backgrounds

data.body: Review (fresh context, role=review): PASS. Verified diff = 3 nav files only, no ASMV-107 leakage. Band-overlap detection correct (rect.top<=44 && rect.bottom>=44); scroll/resize listeners + mount RAF + [pathname] dep cover initial paint and client navigation, with clean teardown. Recolor (useLightNav = onDark && !mobileMenuOpen) covers wordmark, both link groups, and cross; mobile overlay correctly unaffected. usePathname/getBoundingClientRect are SSR-safe (client component + useEffect). Confirmed desktop ClipReel is bg-paper (light, unmarked) while MobileClipReel bg-black + Footer bg-ink are the marked dark surfaces — matches plan. tsc + lint pass. Meets all acceptance criteria.

data.reason: Follow-up: nav didn't turn white over the desktop clip-reel video (bg-paper container, full-bleed dark video). Extending detection to dynamic data-nav-dark.

provenance.reason: Follow-up: nav didn't turn white over the desktop clip-reel video (bg-paper container, full-bleed dark video). Extending detection to dynamic data-nav-dark.

data.body: Follow-up verified live: over the desktop clip-reel video (bg-paper section, full-bleed dark screen recording) the wordmark + cross now render white via dynamic data-nav-dark on the section (present only while a clip plays; light riso cover stays ink) + a MutationObserver in Header that recolors on attribute toggle without a scroll event. Footer + mobile still correct. tsc clean. Screenshots captured before/after.

Per user design decision: whole desktop clip-reel section flagged data-nav-dark (cover + clips), nav goes white across it; wordmark faint over the thin cream strip accepted. Verified live on the cover state — wordmark renders white and legible over the dark riso cover.

Final: per-element detection. data-nav-dark (footer) recolours all incl wordmark -> white; data-nav-dark-media (desktop clip-reel video) recolours only cross/links, wordmark stays ink. Verified live computed colors: clip-reel wordmark rgba(71,31,32,.8)=ink, cross=white/45; footer wordmark=white/90. tsc + lint clean.
